verdict.rationale: Dialpad's API docs show that calls carry associated transcripts and "AI data": there are endpoints to remove transcripts and AI data from specific calls, and AI data linked to contacts. AI CSAT scoring of 100% of calls also shows per-call AI processing. However, the docs only imply these artifacts through deletion endpoints, and AI summaries are never explicitly named. missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI-generated call summaries, a description of how transcripts and summaries are shown on the conversation record, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
